stdout:
Create a milestone

Usage: papyrus milestone create [OPTIONS] <title>

Arguments:
  <title>  Milestone title

Options:
  -d, --description <DESCRIPTION>  Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --json                       Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>                 Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --release <RELEASE>          Assign the milestone to a release
      --config <file>              Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --label <LABEL>              Label
      --no-color                   Disable ANSI color output.
      --reference <REFERENCE>      Reference
  -h, --help                       Print help
